---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for AudioForge
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

Example: "I'm always frustrated when I need to [...]"

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

Who would benefit from this feature? How would they use it?

Examples:
- "Mixing engineers could use this to..."
- "This would help sound designers when..."
- "Producers working with [...] would benefit because..."

## Mockups/Examples

If applicable, add mockups, screenshots, or examples from other plugins that demonstrate the desired behavior.

## Implementation Ideas (Optional)

If you have technical suggestions for how this could be implemented, share them here.

## Which plugin(s) would this apply to?

- [ ] SimpleGain
- [ ] PanUtil
- [ ] BasicSynth
- [ ] CleanDelay
- [ ] SimpleEQ
- [ ] SimpleComp
- [ ] WaveShaper
- [ ] Saturation
- [ ] ChorusFlanger
- [ ] Reverb
- [ ] New plugin (describe below)

## Additional Context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Community Interest

Would you be interested in:
- [ ] Contributing code for this feature
- [ ] Testing beta versions
- [ ] Donating/sponsoring development

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and discussions to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided clear use cases
- [ ] I have described the problem this feature solves
